_provenance.method: read the target's own scripts/scripts.js + scripts/aem.js + styles/styles.css

buttonClasses: a.button / a.button.primary / a.button.secondary / a.button.accent, inside p.button-wrapper
buttonizationNotes: requires an authored <strong> or <em> around the anchor (scripts.js decorateButtons)
skips when the paragraph holds text beyond the link
REPLACES the strong/em with the classed anchor - block JS must not expect a surviving wrapper

wrapTextNodes.note:
#104 - a cell whose first element child is not a valid wrapper, or that leads with PICTURE followed by anything, has its ENTIRE content folded into one

. Collectors must expand the wrapper.

emptySectionCollapseNote: This clone ships NO `main .section:empty` rule. The metadata block leaves an empty padded section after its content is consumed into <head>, so the foundation MUST add `main .section:empty { display: none }` or an empty band sits between header and first section.
globalBoxSizingNote: #106 - this clone sets box-sizing only on a.button/button.button (styles.css:175), NOT globally. The foundation MUST add `*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box }` or any %-width + padding grid silently wraps.

bodyGate.rule: body { display: none } + body.appear { display: block }

navHeightReservation.rule: header { height: var(--nav-height) } + header .header { visibility: hidden }
navHeightReservation.action: retune --nav-height to the Birch Creek chrome's real height (topbar + nav rows)

autoBlocks.note: buildAutoBlocks is project-owned; no video/embed auto-block ships by default
